'''Sonaga''' (''{{IPA|so21 na33 ka̠33}}''; {{lang-zh|锁内嘎话}}; Xinfeng Yi 新峰彝) is a [[Loloish language]] of [[Heqing County]], [[Yunnan]], China. Sonaga is spoken in Dongdeng 东登<ref>http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=18461 {{Dead link|date=March 2022}}</ref> of Xinfeng Village 新峰村 (as well as Anle Village 安乐村<ref>http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=18458 {{Dead link|date=March 2022}}</ref>), Caohai Township 草海乡, [[Heqing County]] (Castro, et al. 2010).<ref>Andy Castro, Brian Crook, Royce Flaming. 2010. ''[http://www.sil.org/silesr/2010/silesr2010-001_English.pdf A sociolinguistic survey of Kua-nsi and related Yi varieties in Heqing county, Yunnan province, China]''. SIL International.</ref>
